using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353LL;
const ll INV2 = 499122177LL;

ll pow_mod(ll a, ll e) {
    ll res = 1LL;
    while (e > 0LL) {
        if (e & 1LL) {
            res = res * a % MOD;
        }
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1LL;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ll n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    ll cnt = r - l + 1LL;
    ll cells = n * m;

    if ((n & 1LL) && (m & 1LL)) {
        cout << pow_mod(cnt, cells) << endl;
    } else {
        ll p = pow_mod(cnt, cells - 1LL);
        ll res;
        if ((cnt & 1LL) == 0LL) {
            res = p * (cnt / 2LL) % MOD;
        } else {
            res = p * ((cnt + 1LL) / 2LL) % MOD;
            res = (res - (p - 1LL + MOD) % MOD * INV2 % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        cout << res << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
